nta.system: // One Reaction process per CTMC event type. Model size no longer depends on N. system Reaction;

query.formula: simulate [<=180; 1] { Sus, Exp, Inf, Rec, Dead }
query.comment: One simulated epidemic trajectory over 180 days (plot all compartments).
Ten trajectories of the number of infectious people: shows the run-to-run variability.
Expected peak number of simultaneously infectious people.
Expected number of deaths within one year.
Probability that at least half the population is infected within a year (a major outbreak).
Probability that 20% of the population is infectious at the same time (e.g. exceeding healthcare capacity).

query.formula: Pr [<=365] (<> Exp + Inf == 0 && Rec + Dead < N / 10)
query.comment: Probability of early stochastic extinction: the epidemic dies out before infecting 10% of the population.

query.formula: Pr [<=365] ([] Sus + Exp + Inf + Rec + Dead == N)
query.comment: Sanity check: the compartments always sum to the population size (should be ~1).
